sloka: तासाम् चन्द्र उपमैर् वक्त्रैः शुभैर् ललित कुण्डलैः ।विरराज विमानम् तन् नभः तारा गणैर् इव ॥५-१०-३४॥
transliteration: tāsām candra upamair vaktraiḥ śubhair lalita kuṇḍalaiḥ ।virarāja vimānam tan nabhaḥ tārā gaṇair iva ॥5-10-34॥

translations.english: There the beautiful moonlike faces of women Illumined by the lovely earrings lay on the cot which looked resplendent like the sky lit up with hosts of stars.
